title: Baby Kent in High Chair at Mill Valley Home, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white snapshot featuring a seven-month-old infant named Kent sitting outdoors in a metal-framed high chair or baby feeder against a backdrop of rustic cedar shingle siding. The baby squints with a slight grin into the sunlight. The front border bears handwritten ink captions identifying the address as '12 Hillside Ave., Mill Valley - Cal.' and noting 'Kent - 7 mo.' The photograph features classic deckled edges and a lab processing stamp on the reverse.
